svg.text: Full Stack · AI Engineer — I build agent harnesses and ship with Claude Code

g.text: › Claude Code reads CLAUDE.md and maps the codebase
› plans first: a spec when the project calls for SDD, straight to code when it doesn't
› spawns subagents to explore, review and test in parallel
› writes the code, then runs the build and the tests itself
› connects to MCP servers, skills and a browser to check its work
› hands work to my own agent harness: several projects at once, each in its own worktree
